title: Sensory overload in kids has distinct neurobiological roots
summary_en: A study led by WashU Medicine researchers finds that sensory distress is directly related to both autism and anxiety, but not ADHD. The research also identified distinct patterns of brain connectivity linked to sensory sensitivity.
title_cn: Sensory overload in kids has distinct neurobiological roots

title: Rural Missouri faces an overlooked HIV burden
summary_en: New WashU research highlights the importance of continuous HIV care as rural communities face added barriers to treatment, testing and prevention.
title_cn: Rural Missouri faces an overlooked HIV burden

title: WashU researchers launch next phase of wealth-building research
summary_en: Researchers at the Center for Social Development in the Brown School at Washington University in St. Louis are launching a new initiative to help shape the future of wealth-building policy in the United States, with a focus on giving children stronger financial foundations that can last a lifetime.
title_cn: WashU researchers launch next phase of wealth-building research

title: Career Catalysts: Pershing Fellow paves new path in nonprofit work
summary_en: WashU architecture student Huda Abdesumad, a Pershing Fellow at Great Rivers Greenway, says the experience has allowed her to bridge her local roots with her career aspirations.
title_cn: Career Catalysts: Pershing Fellow paves new path in nonprofit work

title: WashU launches search for executive vice chancellor, chief financial officer
summary_en: WashU has begun the search for its next executive vice chancellor and chief financial officer. David J. Gray, the current executive vice chancellor for finance, will complete his service in 2027.
title_cn: WashU launches search for executive vice chancellor, chief financial officer

title: WashU Law clerkship program opens doors to careers in the judiciary and beyond
summary_en: WashU Law’s judicial clerkship program continues to grow. Graduates clerk for judges across the country, with placements in 36 states and every federal circuit, including the Virgin Islands, Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands.
title_cn: WashU Law clerkship program opens doors to careers in the judiciary and beyond
